senses.zh_definition: 若原文所指为 Melinda，则为人名，常音译为“梅琳达”；现有材料不足以确认小写 melinda 有独立的马来语普通词义。
senses.en_definition: If intended as Melinda, a personal name; no independent Malay common-word meaning is established by the supplied evidence.
senses.ms_definition: Jika merujuk kepada Melinda, nama khas orang. Makna sebagai kata umum bahasa Melayu belum dapat disahkan daripada bahan yang tersedia.
senses.nuances: 这是有实际名称用例支持的候选解释，不能据此断定输入词必为人名。人名应写作 Melinda。马来西亚用例包括 Melinda Looi；下列为可自然生成的称呼组合，并非已核实的高频固定搭配。status 按指定格式保留为 official，不表示 DBP 已认证该普通词词义。[Melinda Looi 官方介绍](https://melindalooi.com/pages/about)

etymology.historical_story: Names circulate across languages without becoming ordinary vocabulary or acquiring local prefixes. Melinda is demonstrably used in Malaysia, including in the name of designer Melinda Looi. That establishes a naming context, but it does not establish the origin of this particular corpus token. A derivation from Malay linda would require separate lexical evidence, which the packet does not provide. [Official profile](https://melindalooi.com/pages/about)
